questions.question: Which article of the Indian Constitution abolishes untouchability?
questions.explanation: Article 17 abolishes untouchability and forbids its practice in any form.

questions.question: Who is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
options: The Speaker of the Lok Sabha
questions.explanation: Under Article 64, the Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

questions.question: Which of the following are Fundamental Rights under the Indian Constitution today?
questions.explanation: The Right to Property was removed from the Fundamental Rights by the 44th Amendment (1978); it survives as a constitutional right under Article 300A.

questions.question: Match each constitutional body with the article that establishes it.
questions.explanation: Articles 324, 315 and 148 establish the Election Commission, the UPSC and the CAG respectively.
